lia: Heads-up: rolling maintenance tonight 02:00-03:30 UTC for a targeted failover drill on 6 racks in eu-west3. We'll cordon + reboot one cohort at a time to validate BMC/failover paths. Expect short 30-90s gRPC flaps per node and a temporary capacity dip. Ping @ryan @anika if your jobs can't tolerate it :warning:
ryan: ack. I'll pause big batch jobs and schedule canaries to run after each cohort. Which pools are affected?
lia: cohort = eu-west3-rack-{A1..A6} (priority GPU pool). We'll shift traffic to gradient-pool and burst to us-east1 if needed. Estimated impact: ~5% capacity for ~15m while caches warm. No full tenant evictions planned.
infra-bot: ticket INF-784321 created: 'eu-west3 failover drill' — monitors will auto-suppress non-severe alerts for 10m per cohort.
anika: Can we enable fallback routing to smaller quantized model for heavy customers during window? Saves tokens and keeps latency.
matt: Ops-oncall: I'll push a temporary route override: `rdwctl route set --pool=priority --fallback=priority-quant --ttl=900` will be ready 20m before. Also will pre-warm KV cache with `prewarm-tool --prefix 'eu3-cohortA'`.
lia: perfect — please also post a short notice to #support and update the status page. I'll run the runbook and confirm green after first cohort. :thumbsup:
